title: Zero neighbourhood of a section killed on the whole base change
statement: Let $X,T$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $p:T\to X$, and $H$ a left adjoint to the etale direct image $p_*$ with supplied adjunction [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $F$ be an abelian etale sheaf on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $V\to X$ an etale object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Suppose $s\in F(V)$ has zero image under the adjunction unit in $H(F)(V\times_XT)$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. There exists an open $U\subseteq V$ containing the image of $V\times_XT\to V$, on which the restriction of $s$ is zero.

source.place: Lemma 09XM (equality open for etale-sheaf sections), equality with zero; Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback) (3)

from.place: Degree-zero affine-neighbourhood compatibility: the zero locus of the difference of local inverse-image representatives contains the image of their base-changed overlap

proof.text: For each point t of V times_X T choose the algebraic-closure point y0 above t, and let y be its composite with the projection to T. Put Phi = pointSmallEtale y and Psi = Phi.comap p.Etale; y0 gives a pointed object v over V. The general-site sheafFiberComapIso and its unit-germ formula identify the germ of s with the germ of its unit image. Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq compares the standard inverse image with the supplied H, and unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies their units. Since the unit image is zero, invertibility of the comparison makes the original germ zero. This is written as the private pointed-witness theorem.

Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff' detects equality with the zero germ. It gives an etale neighbourhood W_t -> V and a point in W_t over the projection of t, on which s is zero. The projection identity follows by composing the fibre equality with pullback.fst, using etale_map_left_comp_fst and algClosurePoint_base.

Take U to be the union of the open images of these etale neighbourhoods. Each neighbourhood factors through U by IsOpenImmersion.lift; the resulting family covers U, as checked by ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff. Functoriality makes s restrict to zero on every member. Sheaf.isSeparated on this covering then makes its restriction to U zero. Each image point belongs to its neighbourhood image. For an empty pullback the same construction is an empty union and uses the empty covering.

proof_origin.place: Equality with zero, via the unit-compatible geometric-stalk argument of 03Q1 (3); adapts the proved pointed-neighbourhood construction of EtaleSectionZeroNeighbourhood to every point of the full base change.

theorem etaleUnit_zero_neighbourhood
    {X T : Scheme.{u + 1}} (p : T ⟶ X)
    (H : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⥤
      Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hH : H ⊣ p.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology T.smallEtaleTopology)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (V : X.Etale) (s : F.obj.obj (op V))
    (hs : (hH.unit.app F).hom.app (op V) s = 0) :
    ∃ (U : V.left.Opens), Set.range (pullback.fst V.hom p) ⊆ (U : Set V.left) ∧
      F.obj.map (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
        (A := Scheme.Etale.mk (U.ι ≫ V.hom)) (B := V) U.ι rfl).op s = 0
